item.tib: mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol las 'dod chags ma spangs gnas su dag pa'i thabs myur lam gsang spyod rnam rol
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud las/ myur lam gsang spyod rnam rol 'di ni/ lung zin snying grogs mchog rnams kyi gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ kho 'o (bo)kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying pos rgyal mo rgya yi rong gi rab brten rgyal po'i tha gru g.yung drung bon gyi 'dus sde chen po dga' ldan g.yung drung gling gi gzim chung / sa rta zla ba drug pa'i phyogs phyi ma la bgyis pa sngags sems bstan pa'i dpal du gyur cig
